steps.title: Vera Stone: guest review evidence guide · part 1
steps.detail: Vera Stone asks for a guest review evidence guide. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Vera Stone: guest review evidence guide · part 2
steps.detail: The guest review evidence guide now has conflicting notes. Vera Stone wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Vera Stone: guest review evidence guide · part 3
steps.detail: Vera Stone is ready to introduce a paying client for the guest review evidence guide. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented guest review evidence guide. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Vera Stone.
